address: Sheraton Grand Hotel and Spa, 1 Festival Square, Edinburgh,EH3 9SR
bio: Recognised for its relaxed yet sophisticated style and carefully crafted menus that champion the very best of Scotland, the talented, Rosette-winning One Square team work with local suppliers to source high quality, fresh, seasonal ingredients to create outstanding dishes.  The ‘Storytellers of Edinburgh’ Afternoon Tea is served in the One Square Brasserie just off Festival Square. The dining spaces is lined with floor-to-ceiling windows, which provide stunning views of Edinburgh Castle.  Inspired by Edinburgh's famous authors, their words and their wisdom, our afternoon tea celebrates the city's storytellers and their famous tales. Each dish will take you on a journey of escapism through different chapters of history inspired by stories, poetry and prose.  From Robert Burns to Irvine Welsh and many in between, this Afternoon Tea menu draws inspiration from each storyteller's depiction of our city and each dish represents a different chapter, fact or fiction, for you to enjoy. In the world's first UNESCO city of literature, sit back and enjoy as we take you on a tale of our city's most beloved stories!
